description: Same-game NFL prop pairs this week whose legs move together (a QB's passing yards with a teammate's receiving yards or catches, one receiver's catches with his yards): our chance both overs hit priced together with the correlation measured on every season since 2019, beside the two chances multiplied, and our chance and the market's on each leg. Strongest first; `favoured` marks a pair whose two overs we both favour at or above the market. With game_id and two legs it prices those two props instead, any two in the game, over or under, at any line. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

favoured_only.description: Only pairs whose two overs we both favour.

game_id.description: One NFL game, by the game_id that nfl_games returns, such as 2026_11_IND_HOU. Every game this week when left out.

legs.description: Two props in the game named by game_id, to price together. The line is the venue's main line when left out; p_over prices on your own chance, such as a live one.

line.description: The venue's main line when left out.

p_over.description: Your own chance of the over, to price on instead of ours.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

name: nfl_prop_pairs
title: NFL same-game prop pairs
